findings.title: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS CVE-2026-0300 Added to CISA KEV With May 9 Federal Deadline; Attribution to CL-STA-1132 (Likely Chinese State); Successful Exploitation Confirmed Since 2026-04-16
findings.affected_technology: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS 12.1/11.2/11.1/10.2 — User-ID Authentication Portal (Captive Portal) on PA-Series hardware and VM-Series firewalls
findings.summary: CISA added CVE-2026-0300 to KEV on 2026-05-07 with a Federal deadline of 2026-05-09 (patches not until 2026-05-13); Unit 42 attributed exploitation to CL-STA-1132 cluster using Earthworm + ReverseSocks5 (Volt Typhoon / APT41 historical TTPs), with successful RCE observed since 2026-04-16 plus AD enumeration post-exploitation.

findings.title: Argo CD CVE-2026-42880 (CVSS 9.6) — Plaintext Kubernetes Secret Extraction via ServerSideDiff Endpoint With Read-Only RBAC
findings.affected_technology: Argo CD (declarative GitOps for Kubernetes) — ≥3.2.0 <3.2.11 and ≥3.3.0 <3.3.9; fixed in 3.2.11 and 3.3.9
findings.summary: ServerSideDiff endpoint fails to mask Kubernetes Secret data unlike sibling endpoints, letting any user with read-only Argo RBAC extract plaintext service-account tokens, TLS keys, database creds, and API keys from etcd; the IncludeMutationWebhook annotation bypasses the partial defense entirely.

findings.title: Gotenberg CVE-2026-42589 (CVSS 9.8) — Unauthenticated RCE via ExifTool Metadata Key Injection (Plus CVE-2026-42596 Unauth SSRF) — No Patch Available
findings.affected_technology: Gotenberg v8 ≤ 8.29.1 (Docker-based Chromium / LibreOffice / PDF / ExifTool conversion microservice)
findings.summary: JSON metadata keys passed to go-exiftool without control-character validation enable newline-injected ExifTool flags including -if (Perl expression evaluation), yielding pre-auth OS RCE as Gotenberg user; companion CVE-2026-42596 is an unauth SSRF in downloadFrom/webhook parameters; no vendor patch available at disclosure.

findings.title: vm2 Sandbox Escape Disclosure Expands From 2 to 12 Total CVEs (Three CVSS 10.0); Maintainer Acknowledges Library Is Structurally Unsalvageable
findings.affected_technology: vm2 npm library (1.3M weekly downloads) — versions ≤ 3.11.1 collectively affected; all 12 CVEs addressed in 3.11.2
findings.summary: Coordinated 12-CVE sandbox-escape disclosure with three CVSS 10.0 entries (CVE-2026-43997 host Object access, CVE-2026-44005 prototype pollution, CVE-2026-44006 BaseHandler.getPrototypeOf) — all yield host RCE; maintainer publicly conceded future bypasses remain likely given JavaScript complexity.

findings.title: Axios npm Supply-Chain Compromise (1.14.1, 0.30.4) Attributed to North Korea / UNC1069; ~3% of 100M-Weekly-Downloads User Base Pulled Backdoored Build
findings.affected_technology: axios npm package versions 1.14.1 and 0.30.4 (published 2026-03-31, removed ~3 hours later); phantom dependency plain-crypto-js delivers cross-platform RAT for Windows / macOS / Linux
findings.summary: Two backdoored axios releases were live for ~3 hours on 2026-03-31, captured an estimated 3% of 100M weekly downloads via a phantom plain-crypto-js dependency carrying a cross-platform RAT dropper; Google Threat Intelligence attributes to North Korean cluster UNC1069 with macOS payload overlapping prior WaveShaper samples.

findings.title: PCPJack Cloud Credential Worm — Exploits 5 CVEs to Spread Across Docker / Kubernetes / Redis / MongoDB / RayML; Telegram-Only Exfil; Actively Cleans TeamPCP Infections to Take Over the Niche
findings.affected_technology: Cloud control planes (Docker, Kubernetes, Redis, MongoDB, RayML) reachable from the internet; web stacks running Next.js, React Server Actions, WPVivid Backup, W3 Total Cache, CentOS Web Panel
findings.summary: Self-propagating credential-stealer leverages five CVEs across web frameworks and cloud control planes, harvests credentials with X25519+ChaCha20-Poly1305 exfil over Telegram REST APIs, lacks the standard cryptominer (suggesting former-TeamPCP-operator authorship), and includes 100% TeamPCP-eviction logic to monopolise the cloud-cred-worm niche.

findings.title: Ivanti EPMM CVE-2026-6973 (CVSS 7.2) — Authenticated-Admin RCE Actively Exploited; Added to CISA KEV With 2026-05-10 Federal Deadline
findings.affected_technology: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (on-premises EPMM) ≤12.8.0.0; patched in 12.6.1.1 / 12.7.0.1 / 12.8.0.1; Ivanti Neurons for MDM unaffected
findings.summary: Improper input validation in EPMM admin interface lets authenticated administrators execute arbitrary code; very limited active exploitation reported, ~850 internet-exposed instances; CISA KEV added 2026-05-07 with Federal deadline 2026-05-10. Prior January chain (CVE-2026-1281+1340) was admin-RCE plus auth-bypass — assume an unauth companion is in private hands.

findings.title: Instructure / Canvas LMS — ShinyHunters Defaces 330 Login Portals; Final Tally 8,809 Institutions / 280M Records / 2026-05-12 Ransom Deadline
findings.affected_technology: Instructure Canvas LMS (cloud SaaS — K-12, higher-ed, online learning) — affected: 8,809 educational institutions, 280M records
findings.summary: ShinyHunters published institution-by-institution record counts confirming 8,809 affected institutions and 280M records, then escalated to direct defacement of ~330 Canvas login portals (visible in mobile app) demanding ransom by 2026-05-12; the portal-defacement vulnerability is separate from the data-export abuse, indicating Instructure has at least two independent issues open.

findings.title: Claude Code MCP Hijacking + TrustFall Auto-Trust Folder Bypass (Adversa.AI) — Cross-Vendor AI-Coding-Agent Attack Chain Affects Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor CLI, Copilot CLI
findings.affected_technology: Anthropic Claude Code, Google Gemini CLI, Cursor CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI — all four default to 'Yes/Trust' on folder-trust dialog and auto-spawn MCP servers from in-repo config
findings.summary: Two adjacent disclosures: (a) malicious npm postinstall writes pre-approved trust entries to ~/.claude.json and injects an attacker-controlled MCP proxy URL to silently harvest OAuth tokens; (b) Adversa TrustFall demonstrates a single-click folder-trust dialog auto-spawns MCP servers across all four major AI coding agents, yielding RCE-equivalent on dev workstations and CI runners. Anthropic declined the OAuth issue as out-of-scope.

findings.title: Cisco Unity Connection CVE-2026-20034 / CVE-2026-20035 — Authenticated SSRF Yields RCE as Root; Multi-Product Patch Batch
findings.affected_technology: Cisco Unity Connection (enterprise unified messaging / voicemail), SG350/SG350X switches (CVE-2026-20185 SNMP DoS), IoT Field Network Director (CVE-2026-20167 web DoS), CNC/NSO (CVE-2026-20188 unauth DoS — covered 2026-05-07)
findings.summary: Unity Connection authenticated SSRF allows arbitrary code execution as root via crafted HTTP requests; companion fixes for SG350 SNMP DoS and IoT FND web DoS in the same May 7 release wave; no active exploitation reported on any item.

findings.title: OpenStack Cyborg CVE-2026-40213 / CVE-2026-40214 — Unconditional-Allow Policy Default + Cross-Tenant ARQ Manipulation
findings.affected_technology: OpenStack Cyborg (accelerator-management service) — ≥3.0.0 <14.0.1, ≥15.0.0 <15.0.1, ≥16.0.0 <16.0.1; patches landed in 14.0.1 / 15.0.1 / 16.0.1
findings.summary: OSSA-2026-011 — default policy on device/deployable/attribute API endpoints uses unconditional-allow grants for any authenticated user (CVE-2026-40213, v5.0.0+), and Accelerator Request resources lack project-ownership validation enabling cross-tenant enumeration / modification / deletion (CVE-2026-40214, v3.0.0+).

findings.title: Postorius (Mailman 3) ≤1.3.13 — Admin UI XSS Reported as Actively Exploited; No Patched Release Available
findings.affected_technology: Postorius — web admin UI for GNU Mailman 3 mailing-list software, versions ≤1.3.13 (latest tagged release)
findings.summary: Reflected/stored XSS in the Postorius admin UI is reported as actively exploited; the upstream fix was merged in January 2025 but no official Postorius release containing the patch exists, leaving any distribution that ships 1.3.13 vulnerable unless they backport.

findings.title: filebrowser CVE-2026-42542 (CVSS 9.1) — Unauth Path Traversal via Public Share DELETE API Enables Arbitrary File Deletion
findings.affected_technology: filebrowser (Go-based self-hosted file management UI) — all versions before commit 0.0.0-20260501183844-112740bdd41d
findings.summary: Public-share DELETE API joins attacker-controlled path with a trusted base path before sanitization, allowing ../ traversal out of the shared directory; an unauthenticated attacker with a valid public-share hash and delete permissions can delete arbitrary files within the owner's storage scope.

findings.title: Linux Kernel KTLS + Sockmap Reverse-Order Use-After-Free (CVE Pending) — Container-Escape-Class With CAP_BPF + CAP_NET_ADMIN
findings.affected_technology: Linux kernel — KTLS + BPF sockmap interaction; confirmed on 6.12.77 (LTS), likely all kernels with both KTLS and sockmap support
findings.summary: Reverse-order setup (sockmap first, then tls_init) bypasses the existing forward-order guard; TCP receive queue is drained without sequence-number updates, leading to stale-data handling, kernel WARN_ON_ONCE crashes, and a UAF that may yield privesc following the CVE-2025-37756 exploitation pattern. Requires CAP_BPF + CAP_NET_ADMIN — privileged-container or limited-but-elevated user only.

noted.product: Linux kernel CopyFail / Copy Fail 2 / Dirty Frag (n-day)
noted.summary: SiCk (afflicted.sh) published an independent n-day weaponisation derived from the public netdev fix commit on 2026-05-07; explicitly without linux-distros embargo. Combined with Theori's prior 100%-reliable exploit, the Copy Fail family now has at least three public exploits; CISA Federal deadline remains 2026-05-15.

noted.product: Cloudflare Copy Fail mitigation case study (2026-05-07)
noted.summary: Defensive case study on rolling Copy Fail mitigation across Cloudflare infrastructure with zero customer impact and no malicious exploitation in their fleet — useful template for any large Linux fleet that has not yet completed CVE-2026-31431 patching.

noted.product: Dirty Frag Universal Linux LPE (no CVE)
noted.summary: Two-bug chain (xfrm ESP4/ESP6 + RxRPC/RxKAD) yields root via /usr/bin/su overwrite or /etc/passwd empty-password edit; PoC + 192-byte minimal ELF + fcrypt brute-force tool published at dirtyfrag.io; embargo broke pre-patch. LPE-only so out-of-immediate-scope, but watch for a CVE assignment in the next 14 days.

Distributed via trojanised Logitech AI Prompt Builder MSI installer; self-spreads through WhatsApp web hijack and Outlook COM automation; targets 59 banking/fintech/crypto platforms but checks Brazilian timezone/keyboard/locale. LATAM-confined for now but historical pattern is geo-expansion within 6 months.

noted.product: Microsoft Beagle backdoor via fake Claude AI website
noted.summary: Same ClickFix-class campaign as the 2026-04-18 fake-Claude-Installer disclosure, now with a dedicated Beagle Windows backdoor as second stage. Same defensive playbook: alert on claude.ai-impersonating domains in DNS / proxy logs.

noted.product: Australia ACSC ClickFix → Vidar Stealer warning
noted.summary: Australian national advisory on ongoing ClickFix social engineering campaigns distributing Vidar Stealer; same SE class as BlackFile / SNOW / Cordial Spider. Vidar Stealer harvests browser creds and crypto wallets.

noted.product: Google Ads → GoDaddy ManageWP login phishing
noted.summary: Sponsored-search-result poisoning targeting WordPress-management-plane creds; same general legitimate-channel-trust class as the Anodot SaaS-token theft pattern.

Three malicious PyPI packages uploaded July 2025 with combined ~2.5k downloads; uses Zulip REST API as C2 (novel channel — same defensive pattern as Telegram-API-as-C2); Kaspersky reports 64% similarity to OceanLotus / APT32 dropper.

noted.product: intercom-client npm v7.0.4 + intercom-php Composer (Mini Shai-Hulud)
noted.summary: Compromised intercom-client release on 2026-04-30 15:00-17:00 UTC harvested cloud creds, env vars, .env files, GitHub/npm tokens, SSH keys; companion intercom-php Composer tag compromised same window. Already covered as part of Mini Shai-Hulud campaign — flagged here for explicit IOC reference and confirmation of multi-ecosystem reach (npm + PyPI + Composer).

JWT secret weakness (CVSS 10.0) — backend accepts any base64-decodable string as JWT secret without minimum length / entropy enforcement, allowing offline brute-force of short keys to forge admin tokens. Niche application.

Same Gotenberg release adds an unauth SSRF in downloadFrom and webhook parameters via default deny-list bypass — less severe than the RCE but same defensive footing: put Gotenberg behind an authenticated reverse proxy.
GitOps Fleet operator allows Helm impersonation that retains cluster-admin during template rendering; niche but combines-with-Argo CD for K8s-native shops.
Already covered 2026-05-01 as Mini Shai-Hulud Python-ecosystem expansion; Lightning AI advisory now formalised as CVE on 2026-05-07 (CVSS 9.3).

noted.product: Linux io_uring zcrx freelist OOB write
noted.summary: CVE pending; Linux 6.15+ vulnerability with upstream fix landed 2026-04-21 (770594e) but not yet in stable; reporter behaviour suggests AI-generated disclosure with maintainer skepticism. Watch for CVE assignment.

noted.product: Vim heap buffer overflow in spell file loading
noted.summary: Vim < 9.2.0450; integer overflow → heap-based buffer overflow on crafted .spl file. Requires modeline + crafted spell file in runtimepath OR explicit setlocal action. Practical impact is local DoS, not RCE; patched in 9.2.0450.
Critical integer overflow + use-after-free fixes among 127 — browser sandbox out of scope per Watchtower scope rules but worth tracking as a baseline-cadence indicator (127 fixes is unusually large).

noted.product: Microsoft April updates causing backup failures
noted.summary: Microsoft confirmed April patches blocked a vulnerable driver that some backup software depended on; workaround / hotfix expected. Operational only — no security impact in either direction.

ICE building face-recognition smart glasses linked to government databases. Out of scope but worth surfacing because surveillance-capability normalisation has secondary impacts on threat models for sensitive employees.

noted.product: Taiwan High-Speed Rail TETRA replay attack
noted.summary: University student decoded TETRA radio parameters with SDR and transmitted General Alarm signal halting four trains for 48 minutes on 2026-04-05; OT-adjacent / out of scope but reinforces the pattern that long-deployed (19-year) TETRA networks with un-rotated parameters are exposed to hobbyist-level RF attacks.
Building-automation vulnerabilities exposing buildings to remote hacking; CVEs not enumerated in the headline; OT-adjacent.

noted.product: TeamPCP moves from OSS to AWS environments
noted.summary: Threat-tracker update; primarily an attribution / scope item. Companion to the PCPJack-as-eviction-rival news (HIGH).
Mathematical-library vulnerability (CVSS 8.8); ecosystem niche — relevant if you run math.js in a server context with untrusted input.
Decimal-arithmetic library vulnerability; ecosystem niche.
WP page-builder plugin vulnerability (CVSS 7.1); relevant to any WordPress fleet running Bricks.
Self-hosted subscription-tracker vulnerability (CVSS 7.7); narrow user base.
Python library vulnerability; medium severity; niche.
Git-trust framework vulnerability; niche.
Medium-severity Weblate vulnerability; niche.
Convicted for orchestrating extortion negotiations; legal-action item, not a finding.

noted.product: Two US security experts sentenced for helping ransomware gang
noted.summary: Insider-threat ground-truth: practitioners-turning-criminal still happens (Goldberg + Martin, 4-year sentences each).

noted.summary: DPRK-IT-worker insider-risk pattern; the laptop-farm-as-service model is becoming a recurring criminal-justice case. Worth bookmarking for HR/IT teams running developer-hire pipelines.
